mote.name: Tulips for Coriander

mote.name: The Girl's New Dress

mote.name: The Girl's New Necklace

mote.name: Madly in Love

mote.name: The wedding bells toll for thee

mote.name: Legendary Store

mote.name: Bronze Store

mote.name: Put that panda to work!
mote.description: You have a panda working for Pirate Peach. Check out that waddle!

mote.name: Plum orchard

mote.name: Hired monsters

mote.name: Dancing Queen

mote.name: The Girl's Tiara
mote.description: You bought Coriander a tiara, a symbol of young love.

mote.name: You Placed a Mine
mote.description: Well done for you!

ghost.intro: *Boo!* I'm Fredrickson...Friend of foxes, fatally fond of vodka. Skol![br]Long ago foxes lived in small neat cottages along the edges of the ironwood forests.[br]I wish I could go drinking with a Swede again. *sigh*
ghost.during: Have you found a fox yet? My ghostly liver is pining for their companionship.
ghost.complete: You say a fox now lives on our island? Finally a drinking companion...[br]...who can keep up with someone who has already drunk themselves to death.[br]I'm off to the before party. Here's a little something that was growing on my grave.

ghost.intro: *Boo!* Fredrickson again. The foxes are feeling homesick Once they had an entire village by the old fjord.[br]They would gather during the dark of mid winter, stoically drink mulled grog, light candles and eat lingon berry smothered meatballs.[br]Good times. *sigh*[br]I have an idea! If there were more foxes, the ones we had wouldn't be so lonely. Do you think you could round up a total of 5?
ghost.during: *sigh* We still don't have 5 foxes. You can't have a proper drinking party with so few foxes.
ghost.complete: The foxes are so happy to have friends![br]Sven even offered me salt licorice as a present. (But it was soaked in vodka)[br]For your troubles, here's a little something...

ghost.intro: *Fawooo* I'm Chappy, the local church ghost...have you considered the afterlife?[br]It's true. We all die. Then Grandpa Angel judges our eternal souls. As a former ghost, I must say that he can be a bit...harsh.[br]...you haven't ever done anything wrong, have you? Nothing involving...Pandas?[br]Luckily, we in the Church have a guaranteed way to smooth over past transgressions. [br]A penitent parishioner can build a holy statue. For each one they build, they erase a single sin. Simple! Profitable!
ghost.during: Hmm...so many pandas. So few statues. What Would Grandpa Angel Do?
ghost.complete: Ah, you built a statue! If you noticed, your score increased substancially. The higher the score the better chance of getting into heaven.

coriander.intro: The best items are at stores. [br] I think all the old ones got destroyed. [br] We went from shopping at the local shopping malls to digging for roots like starving animals. [br] Here's one store I saved. At each store there is a blueprint to another store. [br] See if you can buy the Bronze store.
coriander.during: You can get maple trees at the bronze store. And bombs!
coriander.complete: Ah, you found the Bronze store! [br] You should stock up on a few bombs in case the evil creatures come back.

coriander.intro: It is certainly rather lonely around here. [br] My mother used to tell me pirate tales! She made seafaring sound so exciting. [br] Have you talked to pirate lately?
coriander.during: Talk to a pirate and tell me a swashbuckling, knee-trembling tale! Pretty please?
coriander.complete: I hear that you found a pirate to chat with? [br] You won't tell me what the pirate said? Why are you blushing!? [br] Was it naughty? I'll give you something if you tell me. [br] *whisper, whisper* [br] He told you what! I don't even know if that's physically possible...

coriander.intro: When I was a little girl, this island was covered by a bustling city. [br]There was this amazing store full of shiny, pretty things [br]Before my parents died, we used to go there. It was called the "Silver Store" [br] Hmm...maybe you can find some plans and start a new store?
coriander.during: What? No Silver Store has open around here yet? Maybe I should stop dreaming....
coriander.complete: The Silver Store is up! Ooooh! Shopping here I come! [br]You should buy something too. (Shopping is more fun together)

coriander.intro: Have you seen the beautiful dress they have over at the Silver store? [br] So divine. I love cute clothes...it is the little things that makes a girl happy.
coriander.during: I still keep dreaming about that beautiful dress at the Silver store.
coriander.complete: Wow! Thank you so much for the beautiful dress. [br]Wearing something so pretty and cute makes everything that happened before seem like a bad dream. [br] So what do you think? Am I adorable?

coriander.intro: Do you hear the munching? It is happening again! They are here! [br] You don't know? They are a vile creature with four hoofed feet. I have nightmares about them.[br]They call themselves...Deer.[br]All they do is eat. Years ago, a plague of them appeared and destroyed all our farmlands. [br]My family, all innocent bunnies, faded away in the dark times that followed.[br]If you see them, please be careful. Take some bombs with you!
coriander.during: I hear the deer munching, munching, munching in my dreams. [br]I wonder if you could be defeat them mano-amano with bombs?
coriander.complete: You are a hero! The latest plague of deer is destroyed. [br]I think I'll be able to sleep again at night. Please accept my heartfelt thanks.

coriander.intro: Why hello there Mr. Charming. I'm even starting to like your little crown.[br]It is so exciting to see you running around build up the island again.[br]We used to have a Steel Store that had all sorts of useful building supplies. Have you thought of getting one?
coriander.during: Still no Steel Store has reopened, eh? What a shame.
coriander.complete: The Steel Store is Open! Here's some money my dad left me in his will. Maybe you can use it to buy yourself something manly.

coriander.intro: We should go shopping together, you and I. [br]I've been dying to check out the jewelry section in the newest shop and...[br]What?...you don't like jewelry? Not even earrings or rings or pretty pearl necklaces? [br]Such a typical boy. I guess...I thought...we could do something together.
coriander.during: I don't know if I want to talk to a boy who doesn't want to go shopping for necklaces with me.
coriander.complete: You went out and *bought* me a necklace?! I just was going to look with you![br]Oh my goodness...you certainly know how to make a girl feel giddy.

coriander.intro: Hello, cutie pie. I was just reminiscing. [br]An ancient hare with a jeweled cane ran a store on the edge of the island. [br]There was a sign has golden lettering. And a spicy smell of decadent, luxurious things. [br]So mysterious. I used to daydream that I was rich beyond belief and could shop there...
coriander.during: What? Oh, I've been daydreaming about shopping at the old Gold Store. [br]I think it burnt down during the Cataclysm.
coriander.complete: You brought the Gold store back! I shall have to go shopping and relive old memories. [br] Here's something my mother purchased there...Old Harold only stocked the best.

coriander.intro: My mother...Susanna was her name...had a beautiful tiara. My father gave it to her. [br] He saved up every penny of his money while they were dating. He barely ate. [br] On this island, a man gives his love a tiara. To let her know she will always be his princess. [br] Old traditions are lost now. I even lost my mother's tiara.
coriander.during: I saw a tiara in the window of the Gold Store. Perhaps a boy will make some lucky girl out there happy.
coriander.complete: I'm speechless. I've never had a boy give me a tiara...[br] I like you so very much and you are such an amazing person. Could you give me a little time to think?

coriander.intro: Well, hello again, Mr. Handsome. I think you deserve a nice hug and perhaps a little kiss.[br]I was up all night thinking. Just tossing and turning.[br]I really need to tell you something...[br]I...I love you.[br]You've been so wonderful. I could love you until the earth falls into the sun.[br]What do you say? I'm so nervous!
coriander.during: What do you say? I'm so nervous!
coriander.complete: Oh, I'm so happy you feel the same![br]Go find the priest! We should get married! I've been saving up a bit.

piratepeach.intro: Shiver me feminine timbers! That cursed bubble was cramped. [br] I'm a pirate and I'm girl. And you are one tall cool drink of handsome after the longest dry spell in my life. [br]Fetch me a rose and I may just lay a juicy one on those tasty lips of yours.
piratepeach.during: I would so love to have some roses planted nearby...
piratepeach.complete: You planted a rose for me! *Kiss*[br]Here is a little something I've been saving for a special someone who I think is delectable.

piratepeach.intro: This island is reminds me of a cheap flat in Stockholm. Efficient, functional, but where's the glitter!? [br]You, building boy, need to give this place a makeover. Fetch me the Legendary Gem Store and we'll start decorating.[br]I saw one for 30% off at the Steel Store.
piratepeach.during: Have you procured the Legendary Store yet? I can't wait to decorate.
piratepeach.complete: Now the real fun begins. Everything you've been building so far has been...drab. [br]Now you can begin spicing up this island with fabulous and decadent gem items. [br]Come here, you. All this talk of gems makes me want to squeeze you like you've never been squeezed before.

piratepeach.intro: I love biting into a plum and having the fruit juice dribble down my chin.[br]It is really too bad there isn't a grove of plum trees.
piratepeach.during: Five plum trees on Pirate Cove would be perfect.
piratepeach.complete: Now I have plums! But I've got no one to lick off the plum juice.[br]Ah, well. Back to being a lonely temptress, albeit a sticky one.

piratepeach.intro: I've been kind of lonely...[br] I figured if I was all vivacious, you'd hang around more.[br]"Pirate Peach's Private Passion Party!" sounds a lot better than "Yet another brunette alone on a Saturday night."[br]Ah well...I've got a little private pleasure when I'm feeling down.[br]It's a Panda! (A cuddly panda doesn't judge me.)[br]Could you put this one to work? When Pandas waddle they cheer me up.
piratepeach.during: Have you tried having the Panda help out with gathering maple trees? I can't wait to see him waddle!
piratepeach.complete: Seeing that Panda waddling about is nearly enough cuteness to distract me from ogling your cute little bum. All this running about gives you impressive muscle tone.

piratepeach.intro: When I first came to this island to pillage all the native men, I was terrified by the trees spirits. You know...the MONSTERS. [br]*Nom, Nom, Nom* And only my toes would be left.[br]Scary! Though at least my amazing pedicure would survive.[br]If you happen to see about five wild monsters, could you tame them? I have an urge to tame cute creatures.
piratepeach.during: If you could bring me 5 trained monsters, I would be more grateful than Coriander might like.
piratepeach.complete: Ah, you used bribery on the monsters! That's quite clever.[br]Now you have cute monsters that follow you around like little doggies. Kawaii! [br]Do you want to be tamed next? Just curious.

piratepeach.intro: Hey there, handsome. I've been taking some dance lessons lately in my spare time.[br]I'd love to perform for you, but I need some sparkly gems for my ballroom dancing outfit.[br]If only I could a 500 gems, I could put on a little show for you!
piratepeach.during: The offer still stands. 500 gems, and I'll dance.
piratepeach.complete: Did you like it? It is really too bad that I've already paid for college.[br]Um...I didn't really need all those gems for my dress.[br]It is just nice having someone so who's cute spending money on me. :-)

coriander_comment.comment: Do you ever get lonely? Sometimes I stare out into the fields and dream of finding someone.
When I was a little girl, my father would read to me stories of princes and princesses. But that isn't real life.
I've looked after my sisters ever since my parents passed. I wasn't much older than they were, but sometimes a girl grows up quickly.
I remember a happier time when I was much younger. Before everyone went away.
I feel that my chances of finding someone special are so very slim.
Yesterday after doing laundry, I was left with a single sock that had no match. I feel like that at times.
What a pretty day to sit and chat with someone new.
It makes me sad that the land is so barren. No trees, no flowers, no cute shoes.
You've been stopping by a lot lately. Why might that be?
When you say hello, I feel like bouncing a little higher.
It feels like spring these days. Even the butterflies are giddy.
So you want to be King? A baseball cap just wouldn't do, eh?
Mmm...I like a bunni who is a hard worker.
I want to marry my best friend. Or a cabana boy.
I wonder if you can handle a smart woman? What about one with ears longer than yours?
Why do you look at me so intently? You make me blush.
What delightfully beady eyes you have.
Last time I talked to a pirate, he told me "I'd love to drop me anchor in your lagoon". Eew!
Have you thought much about kids? After all, we are bunnies.
I do like a man with crown.
*giggle* I feel like we are going steady.
If we had kids, they would have the cutest ears.
Come any closer and I might just nibble on your carrot.

peach_comment.comment: The problem with leather is that it itches when it gets wet. We've all been there.
Mascara is my only real friend. My nail polish is more of an abused pet.
Pillaging is so much more fun when you are woman. Want me to show you?
My father was the Dred Pirate Hareold. I miss him.
My mother was the daughter of a king. Not that he could admit to the relationship in public.
Everyone leaves you eventually. That is one lesson I've learned.
I felt suffocated in my tiny hometown. So I left everything behind and hitched a ship here. Where there is nothing.
Pirates came to this island after the Cataclysm and buried their treasure amidst the rubble. Stupid Pirates.
If Deer took over the island...why are there none left? Did you know that salted venison lasts three months on a sea voyage?
My club entertains all sorts. In all sorts of different ways. Sometimes with candy.
What is up with blonde hair on a bunny? That is so not her natural color.
I had a boy once. He would bring me ripe, fresh cherries from the local market.
Have you ever tasted a cherry? Popped it in your mouth and sunk your teeth into the skin?
Gems sparkle so delightfully. Perhaps one day I'll fall in love, but for now money keeps me warm at night.
Want to hear a secret? This goes no further! I actually have a Phd in physical chemistry. I just play the bad Bunni for fun.
